parts.text: Regenerate the truth-reader implementation from the prior design with this correction as authoritative. Every reading projection must be a JSON ordered array. Do not mutate or abbreviate authoritative source documents. Build each projection from the COMPLETE current source content. For non-JSON text/Markdown sources, split the complete source into ordered content elements using paragraphs where practical and lines where paragraph splitting would lose useful structure. Preserve every source byte semantically and preserve source order. For JSON sources, flatten the complete JSON into ordered path/value content elements so every source value is represented and reconstructable. Truth seeds must be separate array elements inserted between content elements; do not add seed properties to source-content elements. A seed element has its own type and value. Coverage is determined by inserting seed elements at deterministic intervals across the ordered content array, including near the beginning and end, so the complete returned seed vector demonstrates distributed coverage of the selected reading. The worker must return every seed value in projection order. Exact complete ordered match is required for truth PASS. The source docs remain untouched. Keep the enumerated selector form such as doc1=true/doc2=false, workflow-only Node authority, CSPRNG seed generation, separate evidence file, zero mutation on FAIL, and one atomic PASS cleanup commit. On PASS reset selected docs to false, clear evidence/readers back to their unseeded projection state or placeholders as appropriate, and preserve a compact PASS status record. Workflow-generated commits must not recursively trigger the workflow. Return response_type truth_reader_implementation with files[] containing exact repository paths and COMPLETE file contents for all required implementation files, including selector/evidence/catalog/status, workflow-only Node engine, GitHub workflow, and any projection files/templates required. Do not return synthetic abbreviated source projections: projections must be generated mechanically from the actual source docs by the Node engine.
